name: tideline-promo
description: The Tideline promo videos, cut from the screen recording and from window captures of the app, with Remotion.

scripts.render:all: npm run render && npm run render:tour
scripts.web: ffmpeg -i out/tideline-promo.mp4 -c:v libx264 -crf 26 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -an out/promo-web.mp4 -y && ffmpeg -i out/tideline-tour.mp4 -vf scale=1280:720:flags=lanczos -c:v libx264 -crf 26 -preset slow -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart -an out/tour-web.mp4 -y
